# Relationship Analyst Skill for Muse

Guides you through a structured conversation to truly "see" what's happening in a troubled relationship — work, romantic, family, or friendship. It combines a 5-layer structural diagnosis (exchange structure, power structure, boundaries, relationship stage, and narrative) with psychoanalytic depth (transference, unconscious patterns, resistance) to distinguish structural problems from repeating personal patterns. Its posture is deliberate: it never gives advice, only asks questions and mirrors what you say back; each round ends with an ASCII diagram of the relationship structure as currently diagnosed; and it closes with one core insight, one question to carry with you, and an org-mode analysis note saved to your local notes folder. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the skill's instructions are written in Chinese — Muse conducts the dialogue in your language, but expect some Chinese-flavored phrasing in the underlying workflow; this is guided self-reflection, not therapy — it gives no advice and explicitly refers you to a professional if signs of trauma, long-term depression, or self-harm appear; it asks probing personal questions and saves your analysis notes locally on your machine. skills.sh Trust Hub: unverified. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
